title: test(spec): `connector-author-shape.test.ts`'s compile test runs within 8% of its 60 s timeout on CI, so a cold spec run on a slow runner goes red
body:
Filing gate: **① a repo-gate defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: CI, `Test Core (1/6)` on PR #22922 at `63710c5572` ([job](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/38198310758/job/114645914424)): `src/integration/connector-author-shape.test.ts > SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md L3 connector examples compile > compiles every full connector example verbatim, import line included`, "Test timed out in 60000ms" at 61,767 ms. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01KNKBCRDJCu5tGy3TEbvtrF`, under "whoever finds a flake fixes it or files it". ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is failing, and why it is not the PR's

- **The test** (`packages/spec/src/integration/connector-author-shape.test.ts:194`) compiles the document's two L3 connector examples, plus a harness self-test probe, through the TypeScript compiler API in one `it`, under vitest's default 60 s timeout.
- **On `main`** the same test reads 55,680 ms in `Test Core (1/6)` at `85b4ac634e`, `018b077fbf` and `eab7236ff7`. These are identical figures, so they are a turbo cache replay of one run, not three measurements. That run sat 7% under the ceiling.
- **On PR #22922** (a type-only change to `contracts/core-service-contracts.ts`: two imports, two map entries) the spec package re-ran cold and the test took 61.8 s. The PR touches neither the test nor the examples. Any PR that changes `packages/spec` re-runs this test cold, so any of them can land on the wrong side of 60 s.
- **No re-run was taken:** the fleet relay excludes run re-runs by design.

## Proposed fix

Give this one `it` an explicit timeout that matches what it does (one compiler-API program over the spec's types), for example `it('compiles every full connector example verbatim, import line included', () => { … }, 180_000);`. Name the measured CI time in a comment. Raising vitest's global `testTimeout` would hide the next slow test as well, so that is not the fix.

Done when: the test carries its own timeout, with the measured figure in its comment, and a cold `Test Core` shard runs it green.

## Who acts

The next `domain:spec` seat that touches `packages/spec/src/integration/`, or any spec-lane PR that this test turns red and whose seat ports the one-line fix (it no-ops once `main` carries it). `area:*` and the grade are triage's.

Dedupe: the search API is refused in this session, so the repository's 810 most recently updated issues (open and closed) were read through the repo-scoped issue list, matching "connector-author-shape", "SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md L3", and "connector example" with "timeout": 0 hits.
